rejects.event: The Local Autonomy Act established the term special metropolitan city.
rejects.quote: The Korean version of the Charter translated "municipal corporation" as "special free city" (특별자유시; 特別自由市), which later became special metropolitan city (or special metropolitan city; 특별시; 特別シ) in the Local Autonomy Act of 1949.

rejects.event: Yi Seong-gye changed the name of his Kingdom from Goryeo to Joseon.
rejects.quote: After enthroning himself as King at the capital of old Goryeo in 1392, Yi Seong-gye changed the name of his Kingdom from Goryeo to Joseon in 1393 and began his search for a place for a new capital.
rejects.why: The source quote states the name change occurred in 1393, not 1392.

rejects.event: Namdaemun suffered an arson attack before its later complete restoration and re-opening.
rejects.quote: Namdaemun was the oldest wooden gate until a 2008 arson attack, and was re-opened after complete restoration in 2013.
rejects.why: The source quote mentions the 2008 arson attack, but the re-opening occurred in 2013.
